data.body: S2 re-review (round 8) found a REAL blocking gap my round-4 analysis missed: preflight_status_mapping tolerated only BUILT-IN Jira names, so a config REMAP fires a spurious warning. Fixed (behavioral gate finding -> RED test first): added test_preflight_tolerates_config_remap (RED->GREEN, teeth-verified), widened preflight tolerated set via mapping_config.declared_status_names + threaded repo_root from reconcile.py:485. Advisory (two label-diff sites) already handled by implementer. Amended commit 649eecdccb (23 files, file_impact exact match), pushed patchset 2 to change 2018. Re-running review-plan + awaiting re-triggered CI/LLM.
